sentences.en: I will call him the Time Traveller.
sentences.tgt: Je:o l':o appellerai:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: He lived in a big house in Richmond, and every Thursday he asked his friends to dinner.
sentences.tgt: Il:o habitait:v une:o grande:a maison:n à:o Richmond:o ,:o et:o tous:o les:o jeudis:n il:o invitait:v ses:o amis:n à:o dîner:v .:o

sentences.en: One Thursday I came to his house, and I sat down to dinner with Filby, the Psychologist, the Medical Man, and the Editor.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jeudi:n ,:o je:o me:o rendis:v chez:o lui:o et:o pris:v place:n à:o table:n avec:o Filby:o ,:o le:o Psychologue:o ,:o le:o Médecin:o et:o le:o Rédacteur:o .:o

sentences.en: After dinner we went into the smoking room, and the Time Traveller sat by the fire.
sentences.tgt: Après:o le:o dîner:n ,:o nous:o passâmes:v au:o fumoir:n ,:o et:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o s':o assit:v au:o coin:n du:o feu:n .:o

sentences.en: "Every thing is long and wide and high," said the Time Traveller, "and that is 3 dimensions."
sentences.tgt: «:o Toute:o chose:n a:v une:o longueur:n ,:o une:o largeur:n et:o une:o hauteur:n ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o ,:o «:o et:o cela:o fait:v trois:o dimensions:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "But every thing must last for some time, and time is a dimension too."
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o toute:o chose:n doit:v durer:v un:o certain:a temps:n ,:o et:o le:o temps:n est:v lui:o aussi:a une:o dimension:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "It is the fourth dimension."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v la:o quatrième:a dimension:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "We can go up and down, and we can go back and forth, and we can go left and right."
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o pouvons:v monter:v et:o descendre:v ,:o aller:v et:o venir:v ,:o nous:o déplacer:v à:o gauche:n et:o à:o droite:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Why can we not go back and forth in time?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourquoi:a ne:o pourrions:v -nous:o pas:o aller:v et:o venir:v dans:o le:o temps:n ?:o »:o

sentences.en: "You cannot go back to a day that is gone," said the Psychologist.
sentences.tgt: «:o On:o ne:o peut:v pas:o revenir:v à:o un:o jour:n révolu:a ,:o »:o dit:v le:o Psychologue:o .:o

sentences.en: "A man can go up, and he can come down again," said the Time Traveller.
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o homme:n peut:v monter:v ,:o puis:o redescendre:v ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: "I say that a man can go back in time, and he can go forward in time, if he has a machine."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o soutiens:v qu':o un:o homme:n peut:v remonter:v le:o temps:n ,:o et:o tout:a aussi:a bien:a s':o élancer:v vers:o l':o avenir:n ,:o à:o condition:n d':o avoir:v une:o machine:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "That is not possible," said Filby.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v impossible:a ,:o »:o dit:v Filby:o .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller went out, and he came back with a small machine.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o sortit:v et:o revint:v avec:o une:o petite:a machine:n .:o

sentences.en: The machine had a little lever on it.
sentences.tgt: La:o machine:n était:v munie:a d':o un:o petit:a levier:n .:o

sentences.en: He put the machine on the table by the fire, and every one looked at it.
sentences.tgt: Il:o posa:v la:o machine:n sur:o la:o table:n ,:o près:o du:o feu:n ,:o et:o tout:o le:o monde:n la:o regarda:v .:o

sentences.en: "It is not a trick," said the Time Traveller.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o n':o est:v pas:o un:o tour:n de:o passe-passe:n ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: "I will push this lever, and the machine will go into the time that is coming."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vais:v pousser:v ce:o levier:n ,:o et:o la:o machine:n s':o en:o ira:v dans:o le:o temps:n à:o venir:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: He put out his hand and pushed the lever, and the machine was gone.
sentences.tgt: Il:o tendit:v la:o main:n ,:o poussa:v le:o levier:n ,:o et:o la:o machine:n disparut:v .:o

sentences.en: The table was empty, and the Psychologist looked under it.
sentences.tgt: La:o table:n était:v vide:a ,:o et:o le:o Psychologue:o regarda:v dessous:a .:o

sentences.en: "Where has it gone?" said the Editor.
sentences.tgt: «:o Où:a est:v -elle:o passée:v ?:o »:o demanda:v le:o Rédacteur:o .:o

sentences.en: "It has gone into the future," said the Time Traveller, "or into the past, for I do not know which."
sentences.tgt: «:o Elle:o est:v partie:v dans:o l':o avenir:n ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o ,:o «:o ou:o dans:o le:o passé:n ,:o car:o je:o ne:o sais:v pas:o lequel:o des:o deux:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "It is not here now," said the Medical Man.
sentences.tgt: «:o Elle:o n':o est:v plus:o là:a ,:o en:o tout:o cas:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o Médecin:o .:o

sentences.en: "Do you believe me?" said the Time Traveller.
sentences.tgt: «:o Me:o croyez:v -vous:o ?:o »:o demanda:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: "No," said Filby.
sentences.tgt: «:o Non:o ,:o »:o dit:v Filby:o .:o

sentences.en: "I have a big machine in my room, and I will go in it myself," said the Time Traveller.
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ai:v dans:o mon:o atelier:n une:o grande:a machine:n ,:o et:o c':o est:v moi-même:o qui:o partirai:v à:o son:o bord:n ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: He took us to the room, and the big machine was there, and it was not done.
sentences.tgt: Il:o nous:o conduisit:v à:o l':o atelier:n ,:o où:o se:o trouvait:v la:o grande:a machine:n ,:o encore:a inachevée:a .:o

sentences.en: It had bars of metal and bars of ivory, and it had a seat and 2 levers.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o était:v faite:a de:o barres:n de:o métal:n et:o d':o ivoire:n ,:o et:o comportait:v un:o siège:n et:o deux:o leviers:n .:o

sentences.en: "Come next Thursday, and I will tell you what I saw," said the Time Traveller.
sentences.tgt: «:o Revenez:v jeudi:n prochain:a ,:o et:o je:o vous:o raconterai:v ce:o que:o j':o aurai:v vu:v ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: The Editor laughed, and the Medical Man did not speak.
sentences.tgt: Le:o Rédacteur:o se:o mit:v à:o rire:v ,:o et:o le:o Médecin:o garda:v le:o silence:n .:o

sentences.en: Filby looked at the machine once more, and then he went home.
sentences.tgt: Filby:o jeta:v un:o dernier:a regard:n à:o la:o machine:n ,:o puis:o rentra:v chez:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: I went home, and I did not know what to think.
sentences.tgt: Je:o rentrai:v chez:o moi:o sans:o savoir:v que:o penser:v .:o

sentences.en: The next Thursday I came to the house at 7, and the Time Traveller was not there.
sentences.tgt: Le:o jeudi:n suivant:a ,:o j':o arrivai:v chez:o lui:o à:o sept:o heures:n ,:o mais:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o n':o était:v pas:o là:a .:o

sentences.en: The Psychologist, the Medical Man, the Editor, and Filby were in the room.
sentences.tgt: Le:o Psychologue:o ,:o le:o Médecin:o ,:o le:o Rédacteur:o et:o Filby:o se:o trouvaient:v dans:o la:o pièce:n .:o

sentences.en: "Where is he?" said the Editor.
sentences.tgt: «:o Où:a est:v -il:o ?:o »:o demanda:v le:o Rédacteur:o .:o

sentences.en: A paper was on the table, and it said, "Begin dinner, and I will come."
sentences.tgt: Un:o billet:n posé:a sur:o la:o table:n disait:v ::o «:o Commencez:v le:o dîner:n ,:o je:o vous:o rejoindrai:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: We sat down to dinner.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o nous:o mîmes:v à:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: The door opened, and the Time Traveller came in.
sentences.tgt: La:o porte:n s':o ouvrit:v ,:o et:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o entra:v .:o

sentences.en: His coat was dirty, his hair was white, and there was a cut on his face.
sentences.tgt: Il:o avait:v la:o veste:n sale:a ,:o les:o cheveux:n blancs:a et:o une:o entaille:n au:o visage:n .:o

sentences.en: He walked with a limp.
sentences.tgt: Il:o boitait:v .:o

sentences.en: No one spoke, and we all looked at him.
sentences.tgt: Personne:o ne:o disait:v mot:n ,:o et:o nous:o le:o dévisagions:v tous:o .:o

sentences.en: "Are you hurt?" said the Medical Man.
sentences.tgt: «:o Êtes:v -vous:o blessé:a ?:o »:o demanda:v le:o Médecin:o .:o

sentences.en: "I am not hurt," said the Time Traveller.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o suis:v pas:o blessé:a ,:o »:o répondit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: "I want food and drink."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o me:o faut:v à:o manger:v et:o à:o boire:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: He drank a glass of wine, and he went out of the room.
sentences.tgt: Il:o but:v un:o verre:n de:o vin:n et:o quitta:v la:o pièce:n .:o

sentences.en: When he came back, he sat down and ate.
sentences.tgt: À:o son:o retour:n ,:o il:o s':o assit:v et:o mangea:v .:o

sentences.en: "Where have you been?" said the Editor.
sentences.tgt: «:o Où:a étiez:v -vous:o donc:o passé:v ?:o »:o demanda:v le:o Rédacteur:o .:o

sentences.en: "Let me eat," said the Time Traveller, "and then I will tell you a story."
sentences.tgt: «:o Laissez:v -moi:o manger:v ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o ,:o «:o et:o ensuite:a je:o vous:o raconterai:v une:o histoire:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "You will not believe it."
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o n':o y:o croirez:v pas:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: After dinner we went into the smoking room, and the Time Traveller sat by the fire.
sentences.tgt: Après:o le:o dîner:n ,:o nous:o passâmes:v au:o fumoir:n ,:o et:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o s':o assit:v au:o coin:n du:o feu:n .:o

sentences.en: "I have been in the time that is coming, and I have come back," said the Time Traveller.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o suis:v allé:v dans:o le:o temps:n à:o venir:v ,:o et:o j':o en:o suis:v revenu:v ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: "The machine in my room is a real machine."
sentences.tgt: «:o La:o machine:n de:o mon:o atelier:n est:v bien:a réelle:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I will tell you the story, and you will say nothing."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vais:v vous:o raconter:v mon:o histoire:n ,:o et:o vous:o m':o écouterez:v sans:o rien:o dire:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Do you promise?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o me:o le:o promettez:v ?:o »:o

sentences.en: "We promise," said the Psychologist, and the Editor laughed.
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o le:o promettons:v ,:o »:o dit:v le:o Psychologue:o ,:o et:o le:o Rédacteur:o éclata:v de:o rire:v .:o

sentences.en: This is the story that the Time Traveller told us, and I will tell it as he told it.
sentences.tgt: Voici:o l':o histoire:n que:o nous:o conta:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o ,:o et:o je:o la:o rapporterai:v telle:a qu':o il:o nous:o la:o conta:v .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller sat on the big machine that day.
sentences.tgt: Ce:o jour-là:n ,:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o s':o installa:v sur:o la:o grande:a machine:n .:o

sentences.en: He had one hand on the lever that sent the machine forward, and he had one hand on the lever that stopped it.
sentences.tgt: Il:o avait:v une:o main:n sur:o le:o levier:n qui:o lançait:v la:o machine:n en:o avant:a ,:o et:o l':o autre:o sur:o celui:o qui:o l':o arrêtait:v .:o

sentences.en: He pushed the lever, and the room went dark, and then it was light, and then it was dark again.
sentences.tgt: Il:o poussa:v le:o levier:n ,:o et:o l':o atelier:n s':o obscurcit:v ,:o puis:o s':o éclaira:v ,:o puis:o redevint:v obscure:a .:o

sentences.en: Day and night came again and again, and each was too short to see.
sentences.tgt: Le:o jour:n et:o la:o nuit:n se:o succédaient:v sans:o relâche:n ,:o chacun:o trop:a bref:a pour:o qu':o on:o pût:v le:o distinguer:v .:o

sentences.en: The sun went by in a minute, and each minute was one day.
sentences.tgt: Le:o soleil:n traversait:v le:o ciel:n en:o une:o minute:n ,:o et:o chaque:o minute:n valait:v un:o jour:n .:o

sentences.en: The houses fell down, and new houses came, and trees came and went.
sentences.tgt: Les:o maisons:n s':o écroulaient:v ,:o d':o autres:o s':o élevaient:v à:o leur:o place:n ,:o et:o les:o arbres:n poussaient:v puis:o mouraient:v .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller was afraid that the machine would hit a house, so he pushed the lever more.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o craignait:v que:o la:o machine:n ne:o heurtât:v une:o maison:n ,:o aussi:o poussa:v -t-il:o le:o levier:n plus:a loin:a .:o

sentences.en: He could not see day and night now, and the sun was a light in the sky.
sentences.tgt: Il:o ne:o distinguait:v plus:o le:o jour:n de:o la:o nuit:n ,:o et:o le:o soleil:n n':o était:v plus:o qu':o une:o lueur:n dans:o le:o ciel:n .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller wanted to stop, and he pushed the other lever.
sentences.tgt: Voulant:v s':o arrêter:v ,:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o poussa:v l':o autre:a levier:n .:o

sentences.en: The machine turned over, and he fell down.
sentences.tgt: La:o machine:n se:o renversa:v ,:o et:o il:o fut:v projeté:v à:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: Hail fell on him, and he got up.
sentences.tgt: Sous:o la:o grêle:n qui:o s':o abattait:v sur:o lui:o ,:o il:o se:o releva:v .:o

sentences.en: He looked, and he saw a big sphinx of white stone, and it had wings.
sentences.tgt: Il:o regarda:v autour:o de:o lui:o et:o aperçut:v un:o grand:a sphinx:n ailé:a ,:o taillé:a dans:o une:o pierre:n blanche:a .:o

sentences.en: The hail stopped, and the sun came out.
sentences.tgt: La:o grêle:n cessa:v ,:o et:o le:o soleil:n parut:v .:o

sentences.en: He took the levers off the machine and put them in his pocket, so that no one could use it.
sentences.tgt: Il:o démonta:v les:o leviers:n de:o la:o machine:n et:o les:o glissa:v dans:o sa:o poche:n ,:o afin:o que:o personne:o ne:o pût:v s':o en:o servir:v .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller saw many big houses, and he did not see one man.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o apercevait:v de:o nombreux:a et:o vastes:a édifices:n ,:o mais:o pas:o un:o seul:a homme:n .:o

sentences.en: He was afraid of the time he had come to, for he did not know how far he had gone.
sentences.tgt: Il:o redoutait:v l':o époque:n à:o laquelle:o il:o était:v parvenu:v ,:o car:o il:o ignorait:v jusqu':o où:a il:o était:v allé:v .:o

sentences.en: "I have come to a time when men are not the men I know," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o suis:v arrivé:v à:o une:o époque:n où:o les:o hommes:n ne:o sont:v plus:o ceux:o que:o je:o connais:v ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: Some people came up the hill toward the Time Traveller, and they were small.
sentences.tgt: Quelques:o êtres:n de:o petite:a taille:n gravirent:v la:o colline:n à:o la:o rencontre:n de:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: The biggest was not as tall as a man, and each had a small coat and long hair.
sentences.tgt: Le:o plus:a grand:a d':o entre:o eux:o n':o avait:v pas:o la:o taille:n d':o un:o homme:n ,:o et:o chacun:o portait:v une:o courte:a tunique:n et:o les:o cheveux:n longs:a .:o

sentences.en: The people were beautiful, and they were not afraid, and they came near and looked at him.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o étaient:v beaux:a et:o nullement:a craintifs:a ,:o et:o ils:o s':o approchèrent:v pour:o le:o dévisager:v .:o

sentences.en: "Good day," said the Time Traveller.
sentences.tgt: «:o Bonjour:o ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: The people laughed, and they said some words, and he did not know the words.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o rirent:v et:o prononcèrent:v quelques:o mots:n qu':o il:o ne:o comprit:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: One of them pointed at the sky and made a noise of thunder, and the Time Traveller shook his head.
sentences.tgt: L':o un:o d':o eux:o montra:v le:o ciel:n du:o doigt:n en:o imitant:v le:o grondement:n du:o tonnerre:n ,:o et:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o secoua:v la:o tête:n .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller put his hand on his chest and said, "I am the Time Traveller."
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o posa:v la:o main:n sur:o sa:o poitrine:n et:o dit:v ::o «:o Je:o suis:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: One of the people touched his hand, and the rest laughed.
sentences.tgt: L':o un:o d':o eux:o lui:o effleura:v la:o main:n ,:o et:o les:o autres:o éclatèrent:v de:o rire:v .:o

sentences.en: They gave him flowers, and they took him by the hand, and he went with them down the hill.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o lui:o offrirent:v des:o fleurs:n ,:o le:o prirent:v par:o la:o main:n ,:o et:o il:o descendit:v la:o colline:n avec:o eux:o .:o

sentences.en: They came to a big house, and it was old, and the little people went in.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o arrivèrent:v devant:o un:o grand:a édifice:n très:a ancien:a ,:o où:o les:o petits:a êtres:n entrèrent:v .:o

sentences.en: The big house was a hall, and it was old, and there were tables in it.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v une:o vaste:a salle:n ,:o ancienne:a elle:o aussi:a ,:o garnie:a de:o tables:n .:o

sentences.en: The little people sat on the floor, and they gave the Time Traveller fruit.
sentences.tgt: Les:o petits:a êtres:n s':o assirent:v par:o terre:n et:o offrirent:v des:o fruits:n à:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: The fruit was sweet, and he ate it, for he was hungry.
sentences.tgt: Les:o fruits:n étaient:v sucrés:a ,:o et:o il:o les:o mangea:v ,:o car:o il:o avait:v faim:n .:o

sentences.en: The little people ate fruit too, and they did not eat meat.
sentences.tgt: Les:o petits:a êtres:n mangeaient:v eux:o aussi:a des:o fruits:n ,:o mais:o jamais:o de:o viande:n .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller pointed at a thing, and the little people said its name, and he said it after them.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o désignait:v un:o objet:n ,:o les:o petits:a êtres:n le:o nommaient:v ,:o et:o il:o répétait:v le:o mot:n après:o eux:o .:o

sentences.en: In a day he knew many words, and the people laughed at his words.
sentences.tgt: En:o un:o jour:n ,:o il:o apprit:v bon:a nombre:n de:o mots:n ,:o et:o les:o petits:a êtres:n riaient:v de:o sa:o façon:n de:o les:o prononcer:v .:o

sentences.en: They were tired after a few words, and they went away to play.
sentences.tgt: Au:o bout:n de:o quelques:o mots:n ,:o ils:o se:o lassaient:v et:o s':o en:o allaient:v jouer:v .:o

sentences.en: They did not like to work, and they did not like to think.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o n':o aimaient:v ni:o travailler:v ni:o réfléchir:v .:o

sentences.en: All the people were small and beautiful, and they all had the same coat.
sentences.tgt: Tous:o étaient:v petits:a et:o beaux:a ,:o et:o tous:o portaient:v la:o même:a tunique:n .:o

sentences.en: There was no old man and no old woman, and there was no work.
sentences.tgt: On:o ne:o voyait:v ni:o vieillard:n ni:o vieille:a femme:n ,:o et:o nul:o ne:o travaillait:v .:o

sentences.en: There were no fields, and there were no fences.
sentences.tgt: Il:o n':o y:o avait:v ni:o champs:n ni:o clôtures:n .:o

sentences.en: The houses were big and old, and some had fallen down.
sentences.tgt: Les:o édifices:n étaient:v vastes:a et:o anciens:a ,:o et:o certains:o s':o étaient:v effondrés:v .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller sat alone on the hill and looked at the sun.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o s':o assit:v seul:a sur:o la:o colline:n et:o contempla:v le:o soleil:n .:o

sentences.en: "Men no longer need to work, for they have all that they want," he said to himself.
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o hommes:n n':o ont:v plus:o besoin:n de:o travailler:v ,:o car:o ils:o ont:v tout:o ce:o qu':o ils:o désirent:v ,:o »:o se:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "There is no war, and there is no money, and there is no need to be strong."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o n':o y:o a:v plus:o de:o guerre:n ,:o plus:o d':o argent:n ,:o plus:o besoin:n d':o être:v fort:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "When men have no need to work, they do not think."
sentences.tgt: «:o Quand:o les:o hommes:n n':o ont:v plus:o besoin:n de:o travailler:v ,:o ils:o cessent:v de:o penser:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Men have been small and weak for a long time, and they are the little people I see."
sentences.tgt: «:o Depuis:o longtemps:a ,:o les:o hommes:n sont:v petits:a et:o faibles:a ,:o et:o ce:o sont:v eux:o ,:o ces:o petits:a êtres:n que:o je:o vois:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "This is the sunset of mankind."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v le:o crépuscule:n de:o l':o humanité:n .:o »:o

sentences.chapter: The Doors of the Sphinx and Weena
sentences.en: The Time Traveller went down the hill to find his machine, and he ran.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o redescendit:v la:o colline:n en:o courant:v pour:o retrouver:v sa:o machine:n .:o

sentences.en: The machine was not where he had left it, and there were long marks on the ground.
sentences.tgt: La:o machine:n n':o était:v plus:o là:a où:o il:o l':o avait:v laissée:v ,:o et:o de:o longues:a traces:n sillonnaient:v le:o sol:n .:o

sentences.en: The marks went toward the sphinx, and he went along them.
sentences.tgt: Les:o traces:n menaient:v vers:o le:o sphinx:n ,:o et:o il:o les:o suivit:v .:o

sentences.en: The marks stopped at the sphinx.
sentences.tgt: Elles:o s':o arrêtaient:v au:o pied:n du:o sphinx:n .:o

sentences.en: The sphinx was on a base of bronze, and the base had 2 doors.
sentences.tgt: Le:o sphinx:n reposait:v sur:o un:o socle:n de:o bronze:n percé:a de:o deux:o portes:n .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller pushed the doors, and they did not open.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o poussa:v les:o portes:n ,:o mais:o elles:o ne:o s':o ouvrirent:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: He pushed them again and again.
sentences.tgt: Il:o s':o y:o reprit:v à:o maintes:o reprises:n .:o

sentences.en: "My machine is inside," said the Time Traveller.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ma:o machine:n est:v là-dedans:a ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: "The little people took it in, and they shut the doors."
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o petits:a êtres:n l':o y:o ont:v traînée:v ,:o puis:o ils:o ont:v refermé:v les:o portes:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: The little people came near, and they looked at him.
sentences.tgt: Les:o petits:a êtres:n s':o approchèrent:v et:o l':o observèrent:v .:o

sentences.en: "Where is my machine?" said the Time Traveller, and he pointed at the doors.
sentences.tgt: «:o Où:a est:v ma:o machine:n ?:o »:o demanda:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o en:o désignant:v les:o portes:n .:o

sentences.en: The little people laughed, and they did not answer.
sentences.tgt: Les:o petits:a êtres:n rirent:v sans:o répondre:v .:o

sentences.en: He hit the doors with his hand, and the little people did not laugh, for they were afraid.
sentences.tgt: Il:o frappa:v les:o portes:n du:o plat:n de:o la:o main:n ,:o et:o les:o petits:a êtres:n cessèrent:v de:o rire:v ,:o car:o ils:o avaient:v peur:n .:o

sentences.en: They went away, and they did not come near the sphinx again.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o s':o éloignèrent:v ,:o et:o plus:o jamais:o ils:o ne:o s':o approchèrent:v du:o sphinx:n .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller sat down by the sphinx and thought.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o s':o assit:v près:o du:o sphinx:n et:o se:o mit:v à:o réfléchir:v .:o

sentences.en: "The little people are not strong, and they are not clever," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o petits:a êtres:n ne:o sont:v ni:o forts:a ni:o malins:a ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "But they took the machine, and they shut the doors, and I do not know why."
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourtant:a ils:o ont:v pris:v la:o machine:n et:o refermé:v les:o portes:n ,:o et:o j':o ignore:v pourquoi:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I will wait, and I will learn their words, and I will find a way to open the doors."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o attendrai:v ,:o j':o apprendrai:v leur:o langue:n ,:o et:o je:o trouverai:v bien:a un:o moyen:n d':o ouvrir:v ces:o portes:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: The days went by, and the Time Traveller went to the river.
sentences.tgt: Des:o jours:n passèrent:v ,:o puis:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o se:o rendit:v à:o la:o rivière:n .:o

sentences.en: Some little people were in the river, and one of them, a small woman, fell in.
sentences.tgt: Quelques:o petits:a êtres:n se:o baignaient:v ,:o et:o l':o une:o d':o entre:o eux:o ,:o une:o petite:a femme:n ,:o perdit:v pied:n .:o

sentences.en: No one helped her, and the other little people did not move.
sentences.tgt: Personne:o ne:o lui:o porta:v secours:n ,:o et:o les:o autres:a petits:a êtres:n ne:o bougèrent:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller ran to the river and took her out, and she was not hurt.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o courut:v à:o la:o rivière:n et:o l':o en:o tira:v saine:a et:o sauve:a .:o

sentences.en: Her name was Weena.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o s':o appelait:v Weena:o .:o

sentences.en: Weena gave him 2 white flowers, and she went with him up the hill.
sentences.tgt: Weena:o lui:o offrit:v deux:o fleurs:n blanches:a ,:o puis:o remonta:v la:o colline:n avec:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: After that Weena went with the Time Traveller every day, and she ran and played on the hill.
sentences.tgt: Dès:o lors:a ,:o Weena:o accompagna:v chaque:o jour:n l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o ,:o courant:v et:o jouant:v sur:o la:o colline:n .:o

sentences.en: He was not alone now, for Weena was kind.
sentences.tgt: Il:o n':o était:v plus:o seul:a ,:o désormais:a ,:o car:o Weena:o était:v douce:a et:o bonne:a .:o

sentences.en: The little people were afraid of the dark.
sentences.tgt: Les:o petits:a êtres:n avaient:v peur:n du:o noir:n .:o

sentences.en: In the evening every one of them went into the big houses, and they slept together on the floor.
sentences.tgt: Le:o soir:n venu:a ,:o tous:o se:o retiraient:v dans:o les:o grands:a édifices:n ,:o où:o ils:o dormaient:v serrés:a les:o uns:o contre:o les:o autres:o à:o même:o le:o sol:n .:o

sentences.en: "Why do you not sleep alone?" said the Time Traveller to Weena.
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourquoi:a ne:o dormez:v -vous:o pas:o seuls:a ?:o »:o demanda:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o à:o Weena:o .:o

sentences.en: Weena did not answer, and she was afraid.
sentences.tgt: Weena:o ne:o répondit:v pas:o ;:o la:o peur:n se:o lisait:v sur:o son:o visage:n .:o

sentences.en: One night the Time Traveller went out to the hill, and it was dark, for there was no moon.
sentences.tgt: Une:o nuit:n ,:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o sortit:v sur:o la:o colline:n ;:o il:o faisait:v noir:a ,:o car:o il:o n':o y:o avait:v pas:o de:o lune:n .:o

sentences.en: He saw white things in the dark, and they had big eyes, and they ran away.
sentences.tgt: Il:o aperçut:v dans:o l':o obscurité:n des:o formes:n blanches:a aux:o grands:a yeux:n ,:o qui:o s':o enfuirent:v .:o

sentences.en: Something small touched his hand in the dark, and it ran away too.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o le:o noir:n ,:o quelque:o chose:o de:o petit:a lui:o frôla:v la:o main:n ,:o puis:o s':o enfuit:v à:o son:o tour:n .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller went back to the big house, and he did not sleep.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o regagna:v le:o grand:a édifice:n ,:o mais:o ne:o ferma:v pas:o l':o œil:n de:o la:o nuit:n .:o

sentences.en: In the day the Time Traveller found many round wells in the ground.
sentences.tgt: De:o jour:n ,:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o découvrit:v de:o nombreux:a puits:n ronds:a creusés:a dans:o le:o sol:n .:o

sentences.en: He looked down a well, and he heard a noise, and it was the noise of a machine.
sentences.tgt: Il:o se:o pencha:v sur:o l':o un:o d':o eux:o et:o entendit:v un:o bruit:n ,:o celui:o d':o une:o machine:n .:o

sentences.en: "There are men under the ground, and they have machines," said the Time Traveller.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o y:o a:v des:o hommes:n sous:o terre:n ,:o et:o ils:o possèdent:v des:o machines:n ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: "The little people are afraid of them."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o sont:v eux:o que:o craignent:v les:o petits:a êtres:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Weena," said the Time Traveller, "who lives under the ground?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Weena:o ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o ,:o «:o qui:o vit:v sous:o terre:n ?:o »:o

sentences.en: "We are Eloi," said Weena, "and they are Morlocks."
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o ,:o nous:o sommes:v des:o Éloïs:o ,:o »:o dit:v Weena:o ,:o «:o et:o eux:o ,:o ce:o sont:v des:o Morlocks:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Weena was afraid, and she did not say more.
sentences.tgt: Weena:o avait:v peur:n ,:o et:o elle:o n':o en:o dit:v pas:o davantage:a .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller looked at the sun, and he thought of the machine in the sphinx.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o leva:v les:o yeux:n vers:o le:o soleil:n et:o songea:v à:o la:o machine:n enfermée:a dans:o le:o sphinx:n .:o

sentences.en: "I must find my machine," said the Time Traveller, "and I will go down a well."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o faut:v que:o je:o retrouve:v ma:o machine:n ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o ,:o «:o et:o je:o descendrai:v dans:o un:o puits:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Weena cried, and she held his hand, and she did not want him to go.
sentences.tgt: Weena:o fondit:v en:o larmes:n et:o lui:o saisit:v la:o main:n ,:o refusant:v de:o le:o laisser:v partir:v .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller had some matches in his pocket, and he put his hand on them.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o avait:v quelques:o allumettes:n dans:o sa:o poche:n ,:o et:o il:o les:o tâta:v du:o bout:n des:o doigts:n .:o

sentences.en: He went to the well and looked down, and Weena looked at him and cried.
sentences.tgt: Il:o s':o approcha:v du:o puits:n et:o se:o pencha:v au-dessus:a ,:o tandis:o que:o Weena:o le:o regardait:v en:o pleurant:v .:o

sentences.en: There were bars in the wall of the well, and the Time Traveller went down by them.
sentences.tgt: Des:o barreaux:n étaient:v scellés:a dans:o la:o paroi:n du:o puits:n ,:o et:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o s':o en:o servit:v pour:o descendre:v .:o

sentences.en: It was dark, and the noise of the machines was loud.
sentences.tgt: Il:o faisait:v noir:a ,:o et:o le:o bruit:n des:o machines:n était:v assourdissant:a .:o

sentences.en: He went down for a long time, and his arms were tired.
sentences.tgt: Il:o descendit:v longtemps:a ,:o et:o ses:o bras:n commençaient:v à:o faiblir:v .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller did not know how deep the well was, and he did not stop.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o ignorait:v la:o profondeur:n du:o puits:n ,:o mais:o il:o ne:o s':o arrêta:v pas:o .:o

sentences.chapter: The Morlocks and the Two Peoples
sentences.en: At the bottom of the well was a big room, and it was dark and warm.
sentences.tgt: Au:o fond:n du:o puits:n s':o ouvrait:v une:o vaste:a salle:n ,:o sombre:a et:o chaude:a .:o

sentences.en: The noise of the machines was loud, and the Time Traveller could not hear his own voice.
sentences.tgt: Le:o bruit:n des:o machines:n était:v tel:a que:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o ne:o s':o entendait:v plus:o parler:v .:o

sentences.en: He struck a match, and he saw a white thing, and it had big eyes.
sentences.tgt: Il:o frotta:v une:o allumette:n et:o aperçut:v une:o forme:n blanche:a aux:o grands:a yeux:n .:o

sentences.en: The white thing ran away, and the match went out.
sentences.tgt: La:o forme:n blanche:a s':o enfuit:v ,:o et:o l':o allumette:n s':o éteignit:v .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller struck more matches, and he saw a table, and there was meat on the table.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o frotta:v d':o autres:a allumettes:n et:o distingua:v une:o table:n sur:o laquelle:o reposait:v de:o la:o viande:n .:o

sentences.en: He did not know what meat it was.
sentences.tgt: Il:o n':o aurait:v su:v dire:v de:o quelle:o viande:n il:o s':o agissait:v .:o

sentences.en: Many white things came near him, and they were the Morlocks.
sentences.tgt: De:o nombreuses:a formes:n blanches:a s':o approchèrent:v de:o lui:o ::o c':o étaient:v les:o Morlocks:o .:o

sentences.en: The match went out, and something touched his neck.
sentences.tgt: L':o allumette:n s':o éteignit:v ,:o et:o quelque:o chose:o lui:o effleura:v le:o cou:n .:o

sentences.en: "Go away!" said the Time Traveller, and he struck a match.
sentences.tgt: «:o Allez:v -vous-en:o !:o »:o cria:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o en:o frottant:v une:o allumette:n .:o

sentences.en: The Morlocks were afraid of the light, and they went away from him.
sentences.tgt: Les:o Morlocks:o craignaient:v la:o lumière:n ,:o et:o ils:o s':o écartèrent:v de:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller went up the bars, and a hand took his foot.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o remonta:v par:o les:o barreaux:n ,:o mais:o une:o main:n lui:o agrippa:v le:o pied:n .:o

sentences.en: He kicked, and the hand let go, and he went up and up.
sentences.tgt: Il:o donna:v un:o coup:n de:o pied:n ,:o la:o main:n lâcha:v prise:n ,:o et:o il:o grimpa:v ,:o grimpa:v encore:a .:o

sentences.en: He came out into the day, and the sun was bright, and he was sick and tired.
sentences.tgt: Il:o déboucha:v au:o grand:a jour:n ,:o nauséeux:a et:o épuisé:a ,:o sous:o un:o soleil:n éclatant:a .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller was not hurt, but his foot was cut.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o n':o était:v pas:o blessé:a ,:o si:o ce:o n':o est:v une:o coupure:n au:o pied:n .:o

sentences.en: Weena came to him, and she held his hand.
sentences.tgt: Weena:o accourut:v vers:o lui:o et:o lui:o prit:v la:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller sat on the hill and looked at the sphinx.
sentences.tgt: L':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o s':o assit:v sur:o la:o colline:n ,:o les:o yeux:n fixés:a sur:o le:o sphinx:n .:o

sentences.en: "The Morlocks took my machine, and it is inside the sphinx," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o sont:v les:o Morlocks:o qui:o ont:v pris:v ma:o machine:n ,:o et:o elle:o se:o trouve:v à:o l':o intérieur:n du:o sphinx:n ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "They made the doors, and the doors open from below."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o sont:v eux:o qui:o ont:v construit:v ces:o portes:n ,:o et:o elles:o s':o ouvrent:v par:o en:o dessous:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I must have my machine, but I will not go down to the Morlocks again."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o me:o faut:v ma:o machine:n ,:o mais:o je:o ne:o redescendrai:v pas:o chez:o les:o Morlocks:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Weena looked at him, and she did not speak.
sentences.tgt: Weena:o le:o regardait:v sans:o rien:o dire:v .:o

sentences.en: The Time Traveller sat on the hill with Weena, and he thought of his own time.
sentences.tgt: Assis:a sur:o la:o colline:n auprès:o de:o Weena:o ,:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o songeait:v à:o sa:o propre:a époque:n .:o

sentences.en: "In my time some men were rich, and some men were poor," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o De:o mon:o temps:n ,:o il:o y:o avait:v des:o riches:n et:o des:o pauvres:n ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "The rich did not work, and the poor worked under the ground."
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o riches:n ne:o travaillaient:v pas:o ,:o et:o les:o pauvres:n peinaient:v sous:o terre:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Men made more and more of the ground for the poor to work in, and the poor did not see the sun."
sentences.tgt: «:o On:o creusait:v sans:o cesse:n de:o nouvelles:a galeries:n pour:o y:o faire:v travailler:v les:o pauvres:n ,:o qui:o ne:o voyaient:v jamais:o le:o soleil:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "In time the rich lived above, and the poor lived below."
sentences.tgt: «:o À:o la:o longue:a ,:o les:o riches:n vécurent:v à:o la:o surface:n ,:o et:o les:o pauvres:n sous:o terre:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The rich grew small and beautiful, and they did not work, and they did not think."
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o riches:n devinrent:v petits:a et:o beaux:a ;:o ils:o ne:o travaillaient:v plus:o ,:o et:o ne:o pensaient:v plus:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The poor grew white, and they lived in the dark, and they were afraid of the light."
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o pauvres:n devinrent:v blêmes:a ,:o vivant:v dans:o les:o ténèbres:n et:o craignant:v la:o lumière:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The Eloi are the rich, and the Morlocks are the poor."
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o Éloïs:o ,:o ce:o sont:v les:o riches:n ,:o et:o les:o Morlocks:o ,:o les:o pauvres:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "But the Morlocks are not the poor now," said the Time Traveller.
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o désormais:a ,:o les:o Morlocks:o ne:o sont:v plus:o les:o pauvres:n ,:o »:o dit:v l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: "The Morlocks make the coats and the machines, and they give the Eloi coats and fruit."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o sont:v les:o Morlocks:o qui:o fabriquent:v les:o tuniques:n et:o les:o machines:n ,:o et:o ils:o fournissent:v aux:o Éloïs:o tuniques:n et:o fruits:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The Eloi do not know who gives it, and the Eloi are afraid of the dark."
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o Éloïs:o ignorent:v d':o où:a cela:o leur:o vient:v ,:o et:o ils:o ont:v peur:n du:o noir:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "At night the Morlocks take an Eloi, and they eat him."
sentences.tgt: «:o La:o nuit:n ,:o les:o Morlocks:o enlèvent:v un:o Éloï:o et:o le:o dévorent:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The meat that I saw was the meat of an Eloi."
sentences.tgt: «:o La:o viande:n que:o j':o ai:v vue:v ,:o c':o était:v de:o la:o chair:n d':o Éloï:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Weena looked at the sun, and she did not know the words of the Time Traveller.
sentences.tgt: Weena:o regardait:v le:o soleil:n sans:o comprendre:v les:o paroles:n de:o l':o Explorateur:o du:o Temps:o .:o

sentences.en: "I am sorry for the Eloi," said the Time Traveller, "but I must have my machine."
